name: scene-outreach
question: Which blogs, radio shows, playlists, podcasts, YouTube channels, labels, promoters and parties do fans of dark disco, EBM, darkwave and coldwave recommend to each other?
system_extra:
Context: Inch of Shadow is a Berlin artist (Amir): dark dance wave, sitting on dark disco, EBM, coldwave, acid, electro and techno; from 2026 also songs with his own vocals. This feeds Scene Intelligence (contacts) and the Promotion agent. name = the
outlet exactly as written in the posts. insight = what kind of outlet it is, what it plays or covers,
and where (city/country) when the posts say so. examples = the short context of the recommendations.
use = how he could approach it (submit, pitch, play, attend) ONLY if the posts say how; else "check
the outlet's own page". Never invent outlets, URLs or contact details. An outlet named by only one
post may be listed only if nothing stronger is left, with strength 1.
